title: Fix three bugs in a Rust TextStats module
description: Fix bugs in TextStats: word_count returns byte length instead of word count, sentence_count only counts '.' not '!'/'?', avg_word_length divides by count+1 (off by one).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. word_count: return `s.split_whitespace().count()` instead of `s.len()`
2. sentence_count: change filter to `|&c| c == '.' || c == '!' || c == '?'` to count all sentence endings
3. avg_word_length: change `(count + 1) as f64` to `count as f64` in the division
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
